answer: Each agent can earn influence only after staking a scarce token and completing randomly assigned, costly tasks that are checked by peers with independently bonded stakes. A lantern-style audit samples claims, while a prism of diverse reviewers makes collusion harder; proven fraud burns the cheater’s stake and rewards auditors. One person can still create many identities, but each must lock capital and risk losing it, so fake accounts cannot cheaply multiply voting power. A lotus reputation may grow only through verified work, not registration.
